scope: Local site source and headless-browser preview; not hosted/public release qualification
required_local_cases: actual 1440px desktop and 390px mobile captures; no mockup mislabeled native
320/390/768/1440 widths no horizontal overflow; decoded images
gallery native radio control; full original image links; no-JS readable fallback
dialog close/escape/tab/shift-tab and restored opener focus
reduced-motion disables automatic smooth scrolling; visible keyboard focus
privacy/credits and all local href targets resolve; no browser errors
no form, login, microphone, clipboard, storage or external request from page
visible development status and no unqualified release CTA
English-only speech and Android CPU/Mac CoreML limitations stated
history defaults/platform differences and future-only translation/media/history services stated
image hashes match native artifacts and correct source evidence
initial local HTML/CSS/JS/icon/hero assets below 1MiB; no external font/runtime dependency
critical_failures: unsupported mockup represented as actual app
broken primary navigation or inaccessible close operation
release_only_open_gates: qualified product release and truthful downloadable artifacts
explicit hosting/publication authority and final-host privacy/link/security review
human accessibility and native/editor/device evidence required by full product rubric
review_policy: Independent hidden assessment; public concrete defects or scoped PASS only. Missing release evidence is OPEN, never N/A or synthetic acceptance.
